high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a tweet from Elon Musk's verified Twitter account (@elonmusk). The tweet was posted 38 minutes prior to the time mentioned in the post. The text reads: "Launch tmrw morning at 7:20 Texas time." The image attached to the tweet shows a large rocket on a launch pad, silhouetted against a gradient sky that transitions from a warm orange near the horizon to a cooler blue higher up. The SpaceX logo is prominently displayed in the foreground, with the letters "SPACE" in bold, metallic letters and the "X" stylized as part of the logo.
